name: Acontext
summary: Archived and no longer maintained (Oct 2026): open-source skill memory layer that distilled agent runs into editable SKILL.md files agents fetched on later runs.
description:
**No longer maintained.** The GitHub repo is archived, and a README notice added on 2026-10-24 says the team now focuses on alook.ai; the acontext.io website and docs domains no longer resolve. Listed for reference.

When a task completes or fails, an LLM distillation pass extracts what worked, what failed and user preferences, and a skill agent writes them into skill files following a schema you define in `SKILL.md`. Recall is by tool use (`get_skill`, `get_skill_file`), not semantic top-k; skills export as ZIP for use with any agent or framework. SDKs: `pip install acontext`, `npm i @acontext/acontext`. It was hosted at acontext.io; self-hosting used Docker and an OpenAI API key. From the makers of Memobase.

agent_access.notes: Unmaintained: the acontext.io and docs.acontext.io domains no longer resolve (checked 2026-10-27), so the hosted service should be assumed unavailable; self-host from the archived repo at your own risk.
